context_isolation: fork_turns=none; no parent history; sequential ten prompts per session
filesystem_isolation: shared filesystem, instruction-limited reading, not OS isolation
model: inherit same default model/reasoning; no override, seed or explicit sampling control
tools: read own SKILL and referenced guidance, common prompts; save own raw outputs; no network/install/render/subagents
answers: unmodified original files; root collates verbatim
assessment: source-hidden independent reviewers followed by root evidence checks; not double-blind or user readability study

excluded_runs.reason: Read unrelated cloud onboarding setup Skill in addition to allowed condition input; raw files preserved; replacement fresh session requested

second_review_staging: 40 answers first, then ten replacement-session answers; same reviewer and rubric; separate unchanged review submissions
replacement_session_note: Before reading/generation, task scope was clarified as text generation rather than cloud onboarding; no extra Skill content read

syntax.corrected_copies: syntax-fixes/ contains two separately edited copies, both parse; excluded from raw-output metrics
